definitions.gloss: good omen, auspicious sign, happy portent
definitions.explanation: A sign indicating good fortune or a positive outcome. A formal/literary word used for favorable omens.

examples.japanese: {虹|にじ}は{瑞兆|ずいちょう}とされる。
{新年|しんねん}の{初夢|はつゆめ}に{富士山|ふじさん}が{出|で}るのは{瑞兆|ずいちょう}だ。
examples.english: Seeing Mt. Fuji in your first dream of the new year is a good omen.

examples.japanese: {古来|こらい}、{白|しろ}い{動物|どうぶつ}は{瑞兆|ずいちょう}として{尊|とうと}ばれてきた。
examples.english: Since ancient times, white animals have been revered as auspicious omens.

notes:
FORMALITY: Formal/literary. Used in traditional or ceremonial contexts.

CHARACTER NOTE: The character {瑞|ずい} means 'auspicious' or 'felicitous' and appears in names and formal vocabulary.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {瑞兆|ずいちょう}とされる (to be considered a good omen)
- {瑞兆|ずいちょう}が{現|あらわ}れる (an auspicious sign appears)

RELATED WORDS:
- {吉兆|きっちょう} (good omen - more commonly used)
- {凶兆|きょうちょう} (bad omen - antonym)
- {前兆|ぜんちょう} (forewarning - neutral)
